decisions.reason: The roadmap candidate now allows a cloud model to label the sample and keeps it out as a card writer or checker; the plan non-goals say the same.
With the owner word, the candidate outcome and boundary now say a strong model labels the sample and the owner labels a calibration subset, matching the plan.
The second trial needs new questions and more books, so it moved out of the candidate boundary into the roadmap deferred work, and the plan non-goals point to it.
The candidate title and outcome now name the four marked fields; the summary and other neutral fields are in the measured sample and grounded later only if it shows a need.
With the owner word the spec non-goal now covers verifying that claims are true, and a new statement says what the engine checks; the plan spec step no longer needs to change that non-goal.

The agreement command now compares over the ids of the smaller file, which must be a subset of the larger, so the model labels of the full file can be checked against the owner labels of the calibration file.

The plan now fixes one rubric for the three labels and skip, written by the sample command, quoted in the readme and given to every labeller, including how to treat support outside the passages and partly stated items.
Every unverified topic and key idea is now dropped, and a card with fewer than three key ideas left is marked thin and not padded back to three.

With the owner word, the roadmap and the spec now say an item without a verified quote is kept only if the model calls it an inference and is otherwise dropped, and the plan drops unsupported caveats and limits, leaving an empty limit field allowed in the new format.

The shared passages cannot measure retrieval misses, so the rubric no longer claims that; the agreement is stated as support within the passages shown, and a second look at the full text of the items labelled unsupported on the calibration ids estimates the misses separately.
